integrity: The universal trichotomy is proved analytically from the translation-row support geometry and an exact two-point Fourier calculation. Finite computation is used only for replay checks.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to pairs with support cardinality two on prime cyclic groups of order at least five.
No higher-sparsity or composite-order classification is claimed.
An unindexed equivalent result remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact support trichotomy for two-sparse prime cyclic STFTs
